# Lancashire Digital

> Thirteen years on the client side of digital platforms, at Migros, Roche and localsearch, most recently as CEO of a SaaS provider. Advises boards and executive teams on the business case, vendor choice and handover for platform and AI initiatives; vendor-neutral and time-boxed.

Quelle: https://lancashire-digital.ch

## About
- Kevin Lancashire — Fractional CDO; Thirteen years on the client side of digital platforms, at Migros, Roche and localsearch, most recently as CEO of a SaaS provider. Advises boards and executive teams on the business case, vendor choice and handover for platform and AI initiatives; vendor-neutral and time-boxed.
- Lancashire Digital — Independent, vendor-neutral advisory for platform and AI decisions. Fixed-term fractional CDO mandates and assessments for boards and executive teams, built to end in a handover to the client's own team.
  - https://lancashire-digital.ch

## Services
- Assessment
- Fractional CDO mandate

## Industries
- Medtech
- Pharma
- Regulated industries

## Projects
- Seravel — Tests whether AI language-model answers about an organisation match its approved statements (approval status, indications and scope, company facts). In pilot, seeking beta testers in regulated industries.

## Verified facts
- Assessment: Fixed price after the initial call, two to three weeks. A prioritised basis for decision, including a clear recommendation on what to stop or correct.
- Fractional CDO mandate: One to four days a month, six-month minimum term. Target indicators fixed against a baseline before the work starts; ends with the handover to the client's team.
